system.description:
You manipulate your water release chakra and coat your body in it creating a tangible armor. This armor grants you a series of effects as follows;

You gain a 60-foot Swim Speed.

You can breathe underwater as if breathing air.

You gain 60 feet of tremor sense.

Creatures who you deal cold damage to become Shaken until the beginning of your next turn.

Attacks made underwater do not need to be rolled at disadvantage.

Attacks you make while underwater retain their full range.

Can make a Atlantean Trident attack in place of a weapon attack made with the attack action.

Atlantean Trident (melee). melee Ninjutsu Attack, reach 5ft, Hit: 2d8 + Ninjutsu ability modifier cold damage.

Atlantean Trident (ranged) ranged Ninjutsu Attack, reach 60ft, Hit: 1d8 + Ninjutsu ability modifier cold damage

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, Atlantean Trident attacks increases its damage by +1d8, have a +1 bonus to their critical threat range and when dealing cold damage to a creature with 2 or more ranks of Chilled can have their ranks changed to an equal number of ranks of Shaken. Ranks of Shaken applied in this way are treated as an Elemental condition.
